description: This file contains API client functions for authentication-related operations, including fetching user organizations by email and logging in with organization ID and email/password. It interacts with external configuration, utility functions, and URL resolution modules.

methods.name: fetchUserOrganizationsByEmail
methods.description: Fetches organizations associated with a given email address via an API call.

methods.name: loginWithOrgEmailPassword
methods.description: Performs login using organization ID, email, and password, handling encryption of the organization ID and processing the response to extract tokens and tenant ID.
